name: NG exhaustion chain full-history phase-1 gate
purpose: Block all phase-2 characterization until phase-1 chain discovery has been run across every historical NG trading leg that can be reconstructed from the available authoritative raw corpus.

unlock_only_when: the authoritative historical NG MBP-10 corpus has been fully inventoried
every trading week containing historical NG data has been classified as complete, repaired, or explicitly unrecoverable
Sunday-reopen coverage is present for every usable trading week
the week-continuous exhaustion event table has been rebuilt across the entire usable historical corpus
retrospective structural phase-1 order-depth and origin-persistence tests have been rerun across the full history
causally executable phase-1 order-depth tests have been rerun across the full history
full-history results have been frozen with coverage, exclusions, and uncertainty
a new-chat handoff has been committed

authoritative_coverage.scope: all historical NG MBP-10 trading data actually present in the authoritative store, not only the three initial validation weeks
authoritative_coverage.initial_three_weeks_role: pilot/equivalence/validation subset only; their phase-1 findings cannot define final historical chain depth by themselves
authoritative_coverage.partial_week_policy: A week with any historical NG data but missing required continuity must be investigated and repaired from an existing object/job/source if possible. If genuinely unrecoverable, record the exact missing interval and do not pretend it is a complete chain week.

week_semantics.origin: first actual NG trade after the Sunday weekly reopen
week_semantics.end: last actual NG trade before the genuine weekly close
week_semantics.holiday_or_special_session: follow actual trade timestamps and observed market closure/reopen; never invent a clock-time reset

next_chat_agent_requirement.timing: After reading the full-history handoff and verifying the frozen canonical contracts, fan out the full-history Phase-1 work in parallel before any Phase-2 characterization.
next_chat_agent_requirement.shared_truth: All agents must consume the same frozen historical coverage manifest, same week-continuous event semantics, and same immutable event-table/schema. No agent may silently alter detector, endpoints, week boundaries, or chain definitions.

lanes.corpus_continuity: audit all historical weeks, Sunday reopen presence, gaps, special sessions, and repair provenance
lanes.structural_depth: retrospective higher-order order-depth and population-memory analysis across full history
lanes.causal_executable_depth: higher-order analysis using only behavior causally available before each descendant event
lanes.origin_persistence: distinguish inherited-origin from rolling/re-origin higher-order chains
lanes.falsification: independent leakage, null, stability, and week-level replication attacks
